entities.name: Víctor Mesa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Víctor Mesa Martínez is a Cuban baseball manager and former player. Nicknamed "El Loco," he played 19 seasons in the Cuban National Series from 1978 to 1996, all with Villa Clara, and was a longtime fixture of the Cuba national baseball team. He has since managed in the National Series and with the national team, including at the 2013 World Baseball Classic.
